svg.text: ViT-B/16 (google/vit-base-patch16-224), cosine similarity between one slot and every other slot, 14 × 14
every square is computed from the trained table, the dark dot marks the slot doing the asking
each little map is one slot asking how close it is to every other slot
mean similarity along its own row or column 0.46, everywhere else -0.06
nothing told the model the patches form a grid, it learned that from the images
